## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Include screenshots for UI changes. For device behavior, identify the model and firmware, and distinguish physical observation from software receipts. State what remains unverified.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe any protocol, settings, device-support or documentation changes. Remove this section if it is not relevant.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes regression coverage where appropriate.
- [ ] Documentation and translations are updated where needed.
- [ ] The diff and attachments contain no credentials, personal identifiers, private conversation content or local build artifacts.
